reforms.description: The new programme for the advancement of industrial technology has been well received by industry, leading to a marked increase in commitments and outlays in accordance with official forecasts.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The programme encourages investment in industrial technology, which can lead to increased productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The programme has been well received and is currently operational.
reforms.importance_rationale: The programme significantly enhances industrial technology investment but does not represent a major systemic change.
reforms.source_quote: The new programme for the advancement of industrial technology has been well received by industry and the rate of commitments and outlays has been in accordance with official forecasts.
reforms.cross_verification_note: The description mentions a 'programme for the advancement of industrial technology' which aligns with innovation instruments for firms, indicating a focus on R&D funding.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The Economic Council of Canada recommended policies for improving education and training of the labour force and expanding research and development in industry. New programmes of grants and loans have been introduced to facilitate the movement of unemployed individuals to areas with available employment, improving labour mobility.
all_reforms_including_excluded.package_name: Labour Force Development and R&D Expansion
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: Improving education and training enhances the skill set of the workforce, which supports innovation and productivity.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The new programmes have been introduced and are currently in operation.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The reforms significantly enhance the capacity for R&D and workforce mobility, but do not represent a structural overhaul.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: The Economic Council of Canada has stressed that... this divergence in costs could have fundamental effects on the competitiveness of Canadian industry. It recommended policies for improving education and training of the labour force and expanding research and development in industry.
